messages:
maria_ng: quick note from the morning smoke: enabled fast-commit heuristic + 4-bit on ember-13b. saw p50 win but a small spike in exact-match failures for templated edits. filing here so we track.
jin-ml: can you share the tiny summary? numbers or even rough percentages are fine.
maria_ng: tiny table:
```csv
variant,p50_ms,p95_ms,exact_fail_pct,delta_entropy_mean
baseline,130,340,0.6,0.42
fastcommit+q4,95,260,1.7,0.53
fastcommit-only,100,275,0.8,0.44
q4-only,125,320,1.1,0.48
```
derek: delta_entropy jump lines up with the failures. might be quant adding noise to low-entropy decisions and fast-commit amplifies it.
jin-ml: hypothesis: commit jitter + logit smoothing mismatch. we should capture "commit_conf" and "postquant_top2_gap" at commit time.
maria_ng: plan: run two short holdouts: (A) reduce fast-commit window by 1 token, (B) add conservative smoothing before commit. collect per-token top2-gap histograms.
ops-bot: Job `fastcommit-q4-smoke-182999` scheduled by maria_ng on 6 shards. ETA 3h.
derek: also add a tiny adversarial rewrite set (50 examples) that flips determiners and punctuation to stress boundary commits.
jin-ml: will hook that into the harness and keep RNG fixed.
maria_ng: privacy: only token ids and numeric diffs in logs. will post sanitized artifact here. reconvene after jobs.
